mapper.select: select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where type = #{type} and status = 'active' and effective_at <= now() limit 1
select id, type, version, status, effective_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_documents where status = 'active' and effective_at <= now() order by type

select id, document_id, locale, title, sections, created_at, updated_at from cm_legal_document_contents where document_id = #{documentId} order by case when locale = 'zh' then 0 else 1 end, locale limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_user_agreement_acceptances (id, user_id, document_type, document_version, accepted_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{documentType}, #{documentVersion}, #{acceptedAt}) on conflict (user_id, document_type) do update set accepted_at = case when cm_user_agreement_acceptances.document_version <> EXCLUDED.document_version then EXCLUDED.accepted_at else cm_user_agreement_acceptances.accepted_at end, document_version = EXCLUDED.document_version
